questions.question: Before a seven-year famine, what did Elisha tell the woman whose son had been restored to life to do?

answers.text: Leave home and live as foreigners
Stay home and store up grain
Hide inside the walls of Samaria

questions.question: After seven years in the land of the Philistines, whom did the woman go to for help with her house and land?
A king spoke with Gehazi, the servant of the man of God Elisha. What did the king ask Gehazi to tell him?

answers.text: All the great things Elisha had done
Why the famine lasted so long

questions.question: While Gehazi was telling a king how Elisha brought the dead back to life, who walked in just then?

answers.text: The woman whose son Elisha revived
Elisha the man of God himself
A messenger from the king of Aram
